name: Avatar
summary: User / actor identity image with deterministic name-hashed fallback colors and initials when no image is present. Five sizes (xs / sm / md / lg / xl). Square, rounded, or circle. AvatarGroup composes up to N visible avatars with a '+N more' overflow chip — pair with PresenceIndicator (a colored dot at the corner) for live state.

name.description: Display name. Used to derive initials (first letter of first two words) and the hash-based fallback color (deterministic across the app).

src.description: Image URL. When missing or it fails to load, the initials + hash color fallback is shown.

alt.description: alt attribute. Defaults to name. Set to empty string when Avatar is purely decorative alongside a visible name label.

size.description: xs=20 / sm=24 / md=32 / lg=40 / xl=56 px square.

presence.description: Optional presence dot at the bottom-right corner. online=accent, idle=warning, dnd=danger, offline=neutral.

asLink.description: When set, wraps the avatar in an <a href={asLink}>. Pair with a tooltip naming the user.

rules: alt is required when avatar appears without a visible name nearby. When name is rendered in adjacent text, alt='' is correct (decorative).
Initials fallback has aria-hidden='true' when the wrapper has aria-label={name}.
Presence dot announces via aria-label='{name}, online' style.
Avatar-only buttons use IconButton + Tooltip + aria-label.

do: Use name-hashed palette colors (8 stops). Same name → same color across the app.
Use initials for missing images: 'Avery Mercer' → 'AM'.
Pair with PresenceIndicator at the corner for live-collab contexts.
Use sizes consistently per surface — xs in dense table rows, md in lists, lg in detail headers, xl on profile pages.
Use circle as the default. rounded shape signals 'workspace / organization', not 'person'.
dont: Don't use Avatar to represent products — use Image / Logo.
Don't paint the fallback in lime — the avatar palette is its own family.
Don't render an Avatar without alt OR a visible name label nearby.
Don't put Avatar inside a Tooltip without an accessible name.

changelog.note: Initial Avatar contract. Name-hashed 8-color palette. Five sizes, three shapes. AvatarGroup pattern in the same file.
